title: Star K Probable NDE 4635
content: I was sleeping. Shortly before waking up I entered a beautiful world, I don't remember how I got there, one could think it was all a dream, but the difference was that it was much more powerful than a normal dream situation. In the world where I was, everything was bright white and gold. There were numerous small temples. Suddenly I appeared in a small white temple with statues of Jesus, Mary etc. Beautiful music was there. A voice called out names of saints and holy people, this went on non-stop. All of a sudden, I appeared in another temple, there is a huge statue of Ganesh (an Indian God). It is so big and bright white, which is unusual in India. I heard a beautiful song. The last name mentioned was the name of a local saint that had lived at the spot. Ramana Maharishi - that's when I woke up. I tried to step out of my bed but my heart was racing. Then the pulse completely disappeared and I fell on the floor and lost consciousness, everything turned black. I could not feel my body when I regained consciousness; I struggled on and was able to walk a few steps. I could not feel my pulse and thought I was dying. This went on and on until I was finally able to walk (without having any feeling in my body or experiencing my own breathing). I didn't know if I was breathing in or out, could not sense anything. Finally, I found help and they transported me to hospital where I was given heart medication to calm the heart. The pulse could be felt again. They could not find any more abnormalities in the electrocardiogram to my astonishment.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Statues of Jesus, Mary; later a huge statue of Ganesh; names of saints/holy people called out; Ramana Maharishi named last.

environment.environment_other_detail: Numerous small temples; everything was bright white and gold; beautiful music/song.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Episode of racing heart, then pulse disappeared; loss of consciousness; later treated at hospital with heart medication; ECG reportedly normal afterward.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Temple-world with bright white/gold colors; religious statues; voice calling names of saints/holy people; music/song; then waking and subsequent collapse/blackness.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience occurred while sleeping before waking; no reported OBE/tunnel/light-being/life review/boundary; followed by physical collapse and blackout.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience began during sleep and featured multiple temples with statues of different religious traditions (Jesus/Mary; Ganesh) and a voice continuously calling names of saints/holy people; last name heard was Ramana Maharishi before waking.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “everything was bright white and gold.”; “one could think it was all a dream, but the difference was that it was much more powerful than a normal dream situation.”; “everything turned black.”
